title: Theoretical and Practical Advances in Hierarchical Bayesian Deep Learning Methodology
abstract: arXiv:2610.19074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification remains an important challenge in AI. Hierarchical Bayesian methods provide a principled framework for this by representing unknown quantities through posterior distributions. Joint inference of neural-network parameters and prior hyperparameters is challenging for conventional Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods due to strong dependencies. In this work, we introduce the multilevel particle marginal Metropolis-Hastings (MLPMMH) method, which combines pseudo-marginal inference for the hyperparameters with coupled sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) across hierarchy of network-width truncations for conditional parameter inference. The hierarchy is induced by a trace-class neural network (TNN) prior with width-dependent decay, motivated empirically by the compressible structure observed in trained neural-network parameters. translated_title: 分层贝叶斯深度学习方法的理论与实践进展
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化仍然是人工智能领域的一个重要挑战。分层贝叶斯方法通过用后验分布表示未知量，为这一问题提供了一个有原则的框架。由于存在强依赖性，对神经网络参数与先验超参数进行联合推断对于传统的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法而言极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了多层粒子边缘Metropolis-Hastings（MLPMMH）方法，该方法将超参数的伪边缘推断与跨网络宽度截断层级的耦合序贯蒙特卡罗（SMC）条件参数推断相结合。该层级结构由具有宽度相关衰减的迹类神经网络（TNN）先验诱导，其动机来自在训练后的神经网络参数中观察到的可压缩结构这一经验性发现。在标准的多层耦合假设下，我们证明了MLPMMH能够实现均方误差（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文提出多层粒子边缘Metropolis-Hastings（MLPMMH）方法，通过将超参数的伪边缘推断与基于迹类神经网络先验的耦合序贯蒙特卡罗相结合，实现了神经网络参数与超参数的高效联合贝叶斯推断并提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the multilevel particle marginal Metropolis-Hastings (MLPMMH) method, which combines pseudo-marginal inference for hyperparameters with coupled sequential Monte Carlo under a trace-class neural network prior, enabling efficient joint Bayesian inference of neural-network parameters and hyperparameters with theoretical guarantees.
